about: Peak-RSS ceilings for the FP-RISC builds (decision 6, docs/2026-11-11-COPY-OUT-DECISIONS.md): about 1.5x the peak measured with automatic copy-out on an Apple M4 at 1261f167. run.py --ceilings fails above them. Lower a ceiling when a change lowers its workload; never raise one without a reason in the commit.
